title: Kissed Rendered Turkish Fennel Kebabs
description: A quick and flavorful Turkish dish featuring fennel bulb and render fat, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This low-sodium friendly recipe is easy to make and delicious to eat.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Trim the fennel bulbs and cut them into 1 inch wedges.
Mix the rendered fat, garlic, lemon juice, paprika, salt, black pepper, and turkish red pepper in a large bowl.
Add the fennel wedges to the bowl and toss to coat with the fat mixture.
Thread the fennel wedges onto skewers, leaving a little space between each wedge.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the fennel kebabs in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until tender and lightly browned.
Remove the kebabs from the oven and garnish with chopped fresh parsley and reserved fennel fronds.
Serve the kebabs hot, garnished with lemon wedges if desired.
